title: The doctor's answer inside the examiner's turn
context:
Witness (deponent): Dr. Paul Chen.
Defendant attorney: Ana Ruiz, Ruiz Law Group.
Deposition noticed by the defendant side.
asr:
[0:00:04] Speaker 2: Good morning, Doctor. My name is Ana Ruiz, and I represent the defendant. I'll be asking you some questions today.
[0:00:12] Speaker 1: Good morning. I'm Dr. Paul Chen, the orthopedic evaluator in this case.
[0:00:18] Speaker 2: Doctor, when did you examine him? I first examined him in March.
[0:00:24] Speaker 2: What did you find at that March examination?
[0:00:28] Speaker 1: Tenderness in the lower back and a reduced range of motion.
expected:
EXAMINATION
BY SPEAKER 2:
     Q    Good morning, Doctor.  My name is Ana Ruiz, and I represent the defendant.  I'll be asking you some questions today.
     A    Good morning.  I'm Dr. Paul Chen, the orthopedic evaluator in this case.
     Q    Doctor, when did you examine him?
     A    I first examined him in March.
     Q    What did you find at that March examination?
     A    Tenderness in the lower back and a reduced range of motion.

clues.asr: I first examined him in March
clues.clue: The introductions make SPEAKER 2 the examiner and SPEAKER 1 the doctor. The doctor answers when he examined the applicant, so the split comes right before "I first examined him".

clues.asr: What did you find at that March examination
clues.clue: The examiner follows up on the March examination the doctor just named.
